Class AbstractAtomSpi

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.substrate.core.atom.AbstractAtomSpi
All Implemented Interfaces:
AtomSpi, Sweepable
Direct Known Subclasses:
CassandraAtomSpi, DynamoDbAtomSpi, EtcdAtomSpi, HazelcastAtomSpi, InMemoryAtomSpi, MongoDbAtomSpi, NatsAtomSpi, PostgresAtomSpi, RedisAtomSpi
public abstract class AbstractAtomSpi extends Object implements AtomSpi
Skeletal implementation of AtomSpi providing key-prefix management and a no-op sweep default. Backend implementations extend this and provide the storage-specific create, read, set, touch, and delete operations.

    • sweep

      public int sweep(int maxToSweep)
      Description copied from interface: Sweepable
      Delete up to maxToSweep expired records from the backend.

      Return exactly 0 if nothing was found, exactly maxToSweep if the caller should drain again immediately, or something in between if there is no more work for this tick.

      Must be safe to call concurrently from multiple processes in a clustered deployment. For database backends, use the canonical "concurrent workers" pattern for your engine (e.g., SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED on Postgres).

      Specified by:
      sweep in interface Sweepable
      Parameters:
      maxToSweep - maximum number of records to delete in this call; must be positive
      Returns:
      the actual number of records deleted
